title: Act on the Fostering of the Korea Sea Explorers Association
full_text:
ACT ON THE FOSTERING OF THE KOREA SEA EXPLORERS ASSOCIATION

Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Act is to contribute to the development of maritime resources and national development by supporting and fostering the Korea Sea Explorers Association, established to foster maritime awareness, a firm sense of national identity, and an enterprising spirit among boys and girls through education and training concerning the sea.

Article 2 (Cooperation and Support) The State or a local government may provide the Korea Sea Explorers Association (hereinafter referred to as the "Association") with conveniences necessary for its organization and activities, and may cooperate with and support the Association.

Article 3 (Loans of State and Public Property and Support for Facilities, etc.)
(1) Where necessary to foster the Association, the State or a local government may, notwithstanding the State Property Act, the Public Property and Commodity Management Act, or other applicable provisions, lend or transfer State or public property, school facilities, and military facilities to the Association free of charge, or allow the Association to use them and obtain profits therefrom, to the extent that such use does not interfere with their intended purposes.
(2) Where property or facilities are lent or transferred free of charge or their use and enjoyment is permitted under paragraph (1), the details and conditions shall be as prescribed by a contract between the administrative agency responsible for managing the relevant property or facility and the Association.

Article 4 (Subsidies, etc.)
(1) The State or a local government may subsidize the Korea Sea Explorers Association's operating and facility expenses necessary for its organization and activities, as well as expenses necessary for domestic and international events.
(2) An individual, corporation, or organization may donate money or other property to support the Association's facilities and operation.

Article 5 (Tax Reductions or Exemptions, etc.)
(1) The Government may reduce or exempt taxes for the Association pursuant to the Restriction of Special Taxation Act.
(2) Special provisions for calculating income pursuant to the Restriction of Special Taxation Act may apply to money or other property donated to the Association under Article 4 (2).

Article 6 (Projects of Supporting Organizations) A person or organization supporting the Association (hereinafter referred to as a "supporting organization") may conduct necessary profit-making projects with the approval of the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries.

Article 7 (Orders to Suspend Profit-Making Projects)
(1) Where the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries finds that a supporting organization conducting a profit-making project under Article 6 uses or is likely to use profits from the project for purposes other than the operation of the Association, the Minister may order the supporting organization to suspend the project for a specified period not exceeding six months and take necessary measures.
(2) Detailed criteria for project suspension under paragraph (1) and other necessary matters shall be prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries.

Article 8 (Submission of Budget Statements, etc.) Before the start of each fiscal year, the Association shall prepare and submit its budget statement and business plan for the following year to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. The same shall apply to amendments thereto.

Article 9 (Submission of Statements of Accounts, etc.) The Association shall submit to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, by March 31 of the following year, a statement of settlement of revenues and expenditures for each fiscal year together with a report on business performance for the relevant year.

Article 10 (Inspection of Affairs, etc.) Where deemed necessary, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may require the Association to submit materials or reports concerning its affairs or may have public officials under the Minister's jurisdiction inspect those affairs.

Article 11 (Prohibition on Use of Similar Names) No person other than the Association shall use the name "Korea Sea Explorers Association" or any similar name.

Article 12 (Administrative Fines) A person who violates Article 11 shall be subject to an administrative fine not exceeding three million won. <Amended on February 18, 2020>

Article 13 Deleted. <December 17, 1997>

ADDENDA <Act No. 3785, December 31, 1984>

(1) (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

(2) (Transitional Measures) The incorporated association known as the Korea Sea Explorers Association existing when this Act enters into force shall be deemed the Korea Sea Explorers Association under this Act.
